features: New game launcher: patch notes, account and game folder in one place.
Server status and players online, live on the launcher.
The game now loads only when you press Play.
updates: Logged-in players go straight to the launcher.
Switch account, log out and change game folder moved to the launcher.
Fixed a crash while loading the website.
Mods with broken sound files no longer stop the game.

features: Smarter Sims: a grown-up calls the fire department during a fire.
Smarter Sims: Sims call the repairman when nobody can fix things.
updates: Sims keep quiet around sleeping Sims.

features: Sim Smarts: new Off setting for single player.
updates: Sims finish meals and get a full night's sleep.
Sims pay bills and repair objects when their needs are met.
Sims with low Cooking grab a snack instead of cooking.
Sims stop bouncing between the same activities.
